ar.title: السمك المسبك الأبيض على الطريقة الشرقية

steps.n2: يُقدح السمن أو الزيت وتوضع به المستكة والحبهان، ثم يُشوح السمك فيه ويُرفع.
steps.n3: يُقلب الدقيق في الزيت أو السمن المتخلف بحيث لا يحمر لونه، ثم يُضاف الماء تدريجياً مع التقليب المستمر.
steps.n4: تُتبل الصلصة وتُترك لتغلي، ثم يُضاف إليها السمك المشوح ويُغطى الإناء ويُترك على نار هادئة حتى ينضج السمك.
steps.n5: يُضاف عصير الليمون ويُعاد تتبيلها وتُغرف ساخنة، وتُجمل بالليمون والبقدونس.

en.title: Eastern-Style Fish in White Sauce

steps.n1: Clean the fish and cut it into steaks.
steps.n2: Heat the ghee or oil until very hot, add the mastic and cardamom, then sauté the fish and lift it out.
steps.n3: Stir the flour in the remaining oil or ghee without letting it brown, then add the water gradually, stirring constantly.
steps.n4: Season the sauce and bring it to a boil, then add the sautéed fish, cover the pot and cook over low heat until the fish is done.
steps.n5: Add the lemon juice, adjust the seasoning, ladle out hot and garnish with lemon and parsley.

legacySteps: Clean the fish and cut it into steaks.
Heat the ghee or oil until very hot, add the mastic and cardamom, then sauté the fish and lift it out.
Stir the flour in the remaining oil or ghee without letting it brown, then add the water gradually, stirring constantly.
Season the sauce and bring it to a boil, then add the sautéed fish, cover the pot and cook over low heat until the fish is done.
Add the lemon juice, adjust the seasoning, ladle out hot and garnish with lemon and parsley.
